name: Dylan's Daily Torah
subtitle: This week's portion, a section a day
internet: Needed the first time each day (for the texts)
description: This week's Torah portion in English and Hebrew: what happens in it, its four main lessons, and its haftarah.

Then today's section of it: an insight to take into the day, the verse of the day in Hebrew and English, and Rashi on it. Then the Talmud on today's verse: a Mishnah and a passage of the Gemara, each in the original, in English, and in plain English. Every text has a link to read it on Sefaria.
Last, where the portion falls among all 54, and the Hebrew year as a wheel with the moon and the holidays coming up.
features: This week's portion first, then a section a day: the whole portion in a week
Lessons and a daily insight in plain English, written for every portion
The verse of the day in Hebrew and English, with Rashi on it
The Talmud on today's verse: a Mishnah and the Gemara, in the original, in English and in plain English
Read it on Sefaria: a link under every text
The Hebrew date, the year as a wheel, and the next holidays
